notes: «في بيته أنا سألته» places the question at Sufyan's house; it is a place and the asking in the scene, not a link
«قال أو زيد بن أسلم» gives an alternative transmitter at the level of «سالم أبي النضر» (Sufyan's own doubt), written as co-transmitters of one level
the Companion is named only as «أبيه» (relation); the saying ends with «أن رسول الله»
